verdict.rationale: Statsig's feature gates support rollback-like controls (emergency disable switch, scheduled rollouts) and CLI/Console API can be scripted into CI/CD for programmatic management, implying some versioned control over flag state, but the evidence never documents an explicit audit/version history, diffing, or approval-review workflow for these 'automations'. missing for 10: explicit version history/audit log for gate or experiment changes, a review/approval workflow before changes go live, and a documented one-click rollback to a prior version (only an on/off disable switch is shown).
